description.value: The Jin Sushi is a sushi restaurant located in Tsawwassen, a South Delta community near the BC Ferries terminal and popular cycling routes connecting to the Tsawwassen First Nation lands and Delta farmlands. As a sit-down sushi spot, it offers touring cyclists a chance to refuel with Japanese cuisine after rides along the flat delta terrain. No further details about the dining experience or facility are available from public sources.
